summary.text: Kirsten Larsen Schultz is an independent candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A marketing consultant, she is a former Republican state representative from Strafford 2 who served from 2010 to 2012.

paragraphs.text: Larsen Schultz earned a high school diploma from Lebanon High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire in 1996 and a graduate degree from the University of New Hampshire in 2006.
Her career experience includes working as a marketing consultant.
Larsen Schultz, then a Republican, was elected to the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Strafford 2 in 2010, took office that year and left office in 2012.
In the 2011-2012 session she served on the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs committee.
She ran for the House in Rockingham 22 in 2020 and Rockingham 23 in 2022, losing to incumbent Jim Maggiore both times.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Larsen Schultz described herself as a lifelong New Hampshire resident running as an independent and said she believes in lower taxes, parental rights, and a representative who answers to the people of North Hampton.
She listed integrity and honesty, the economy and taxes, and family and community as her key campaign messages.
